info.name: CloudLynk Backend - PR1 to PR6
info.description: Import together with CloudLynk.local.postman_environment.json. Fill base_url and supabase_anon_key, then user credentials. Sign in user/admin to capture separate tokens. API bodies match the repository RPC/Edge Function contracts. Run requests manually in the workflow order described in docs/postman/README.md. Provider calls need configured server accounts. Admin/worker/webhook/binary/destructive folders are skipped until their explicit environment flags are true. No real credentials are exported.

item.name: 01 - Auth
item.description: Sign in the regular user and admin separately; admin login never replaces access_token.

request.description: Set email/password first. Local email confirmation is disabled. Hosted projects may require email confirmation before login.

item.name: Sign in user - saves user tokens

request.description: Sign in user - saves user tokens

item.name: Sign in admin - saves separate admin token

request.description: An existing admin is required. Login does not grant admin role; bootstrap that role using trusted SQL.

item.name: 02 - Profile and access
item.description: User RLS and the shared access rule.

item.name: My profile and Play account ID

request.description: My profile and Play account ID

exec: if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const data = pm.response.json(); const value = data[0]?.play_account_id; if (value !== undefined && value !== null) pm.environment.set("play_account_id", value); }

item.name: Update my display name and age gate

request.description: Updates the signed-in user's display fields and self-declared birth date. Does not change role, publisher permission or account standing.

item.name: 03 - Public catalogue
item.description: Read APIs enforce visibility. Empty results are normal until reviewed content and plans exist.

request.description: Anonymous view. Private/draft channels are excluded. Use the next request for signed-in visibility.

item.name: 04 - Membership
item.description: Joining a premium channel requires a paid subscription. A private channel requires an invitation.

item.name: Invite a user to my private channel

request.description: Channel owner with publishing permission, or admin. Channel must be published and private.

item.name: 05 - Private drive
item.description: Reserve -> upload -> finalize. Cleanup is separate from logical deletion.

request.description: Run Reserve sample upload first. Body is exactly CloudLynk followed by LF (10 bytes). For another file reserve its exact size, choose a binary body and the matching MIME type. For files over 6 MB use the documented Supabase TUS workflow.
Send within 60 seconds of generating the URL. No Authorization or apikey headers are sent; the URL carries the signature.

item.name: 06 - Subscriptions and attribution
item.description: Provider secrets stay on the server. No service-role key is needed in Postman.

item.name: Verify or restore Google Play purchase

request.description: Requires a real Play purchase token, matching configured product and Google service account. The Billing flow must have supplied profiles.play_account_id as obfuscatedAccountId. Fake tokens do not grant access.
Replace extinfo with complete real Android device information before testing Meta delivery. This request stores explicit consent; no conversion is sent by this request.

item.name: 07 - Publisher workflow
item.description: Grant publisher permission and publish the channel using admin requests. Video titles need a processed asset before review. Series containers do not.

request.description: Requires an active admin or a user already granted can_publish. Starts private and draft; admin must publish it.

item.name: Allocate resumable video upload - captures URL

request.description: Set video_size_bytes to the exact selected video size. The returned TUS URL is already allocated; use it as uploadUrl.

item.name: 08 - Stream binary upload (manual)
item.description: Opt in with enable_stream_binary_upload=true and choose a real binary video file. Do not run this folder blindly.

item.name: PATCH video bytes to Stream TUS URL

request.description: Choose the actual video file in Body > binary. For a single request the file must fit the provider's chunk limit (200 MiB); the size must equal the allocation and offset must be 0. For chunked/resumed large uploads use a TUS client and valid chunk sizes. No Supabase credentials are sent to Cloudflare.

item.name: 09 - Playback and library
item.description: Signed playback requires published content, membership, correct age and any paid entitlement. Use episode_id instead of title_id when playing an episode.

item.name: Get signed playback URLs - captures hls_url

request.description: Get signed playback URLs - captures hls_url

exec: if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const data = pm.response.json(); const value = data.hlsUrl; if (value !== undefined && value !== null) pm.environment.set("hls_url", value); }
if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const data = pm.response.json(); const value = data; if (value !== undefined && value !== null) pm.environment.set("report_id", value); }

item.name: 10 - Notifications
item.description: Use a real Expo token from the Android app. Raw FCM tokens are not accepted.

exec: if (pm.response.code >= 200 && pm.response.code < 300) { const data = pm.response.json(); const value = data[0]?.id; if (value !== undefined && value !== null) pm.environment.set("notice_id", value); }

item.name: 11 - Admin operations (manual)
item.description: Set enable_admin_operations=true and sign in an existing admin. These requests change publication, account standing, permissions or send real notices.

item.name: 12 - Health (read only)
item.description: Private aggregate health endpoint; no service-role key required.

request.description: Requires the server CRON_SECRET. HTTP 503 with status=degraded is expected before all schedules have run.

item.name: 14 - Provider webhooks (manual)
item.description: Set enable_provider_webhooks=true. Real provider credentials and signatures are required.

request.description: Requires the real webhook signing secret configured on this backend, a real owned Stream UID and a modern Postman supporting pm.require. The pre-request script signs the exact expanded body; the backend re-reads Cloudflare, so this does not fabricate processing state.

item.name: Google Play authenticated PubSub test notification

request.description: Requires a genuine Google OIDC bearer token matching RTDN_PUSH_AUDIENCE and RTDN_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL. Supabase user/admin tokens do not authenticate this endpoint.

item.name: 15 - Cleanup and account deletion (manual)
item.description: Set enable_destructive_requests=true. This folder changes/removes data or signs out the user; account erasure is irreversible once processed.

request.description: Re-sign in within 15 minutes, set delete_confirmation=DELETE and enable_destructive_requests=true. Immediately restricts the current user and hides owned content; workers later erase it. Does not cancel Play billing.
